content:
Deletes the specified category and any associated tag values. Deleting an asset tag category
automatically deletes all tag values associated with that category and removes the tags from any
assets where the tags were assigned. To delete a category you must be an admin or have edit
permissions on all tags within the category.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
Content type
Content type
string <uuid>
The unique identifier (UUID) of the tag category to delete. For more
information on determining this value, see Determine Tag Identifiers.
